ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Given the thrust force F = 900 N, the firing time Δt = 3 s, and the speed increase Δv = 0.9 m/s. First find the constant acceleration using a = Δv/Δt = 0.9/3 = 0.3 m/s^2. Then apply Newton's second law F = ma, rearranged as m = F/a. Thus m = 900/0.3 = 3000 kg = 3 × 10^3 kg.

Read the thrust as a constant 900 N applied for 3 s, and the resulting speed increase as 0.9 m/s. The impulse is J = FΔt = 900 × 3 = 2700 N·s.
